import mir_eval
import numpy as np

precision, recall, f_measure, avg_overlap_ratio = mir_eval.transcription.precision_recall_f1_overlap(
    ref_intervals, ref_freqs, est_intervals, est_freqs, offset_ratio=None
)

# Oracle 1: F-measure must be the harmonic mean of precision and recall (beta=1.0)
if precision + recall > 0:
    expected_f = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
    assert np.isclose(f_measure, expected_f), f"F-measure {f_measure} != expected {expected_f}"
else:
    assert f_measure == 0.0

# Oracle 2: Evaluating the reference against itself must yield perfect scores
if len(ref_intervals) > 0:
    p_perf, r_perf, f_perf, o_perf = mir_eval.transcription.precision_recall_f1_overlap(
        ref_intervals, ref_freqs, ref_intervals, ref_freqs, offset_ratio=None
    )
    assert np.isclose(p_perf, 1.0), f"Expected perfect precision, got {p_perf}"
    assert np.isclose(r_perf, 1.0), f"Expected perfect recall, got {r_perf}"
    assert np.isclose(f_perf, 1.0), f"Expected
